answer: Seat auctions: each epoch the network admits only 50 new agent identities, sold by sealed-bid auction with the clearing price burned. A gale of fake sign-ups cannot flood in, because supply is fixed; to field 1,000 sybils an attacker must win 20 epochs of auctions, outbidding honest newcomers every time, and the price climbs as he pushes demand up. Admitted seats wear an umber badge that turns onyx only after 30 epochs of graded work, so bought seats earn little until they prove themselves.
